messages:
rachel: FYI I just opened a migration PR to consolidate the console cost/latency examples into a single "compact" guide that shows heatmap query + tracehook + cost attribution. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5310

omar: Excellent. Does it include a note about runtime prefix-caching dependency? I saw confusion in support tickets where cost never shows kv entries.

rachel: yes — prereqs section mentions prefix cache enabled and runtime flag name. Also added a short troubleshooting checklist for staging.

kevin: skimmed the TS sample — nice and short. Can we also show a tiny Python snippet for the trace hook? A lot of customers use Python for server hooks.

rachel: added a 2-line Python example. kept it minimal: start_trace(), add_cost_breakdown(), end_trace().

ci-bot: link-check: 2 redirects -> telemetry-setup.md, dashboards-migration.md. Marked as warnings on PR #5310.

sarah: suggestion: replace the redirecting links with canonical docs.redwood.ai paths and add a footnote that old paths will redirect until April 2026. Saves repeated CI failures.

rachel: good call. patched links and added the footnote. pushed update: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5310/files

omar: also small UX nit: the dashboard query in the heatmap example used an old time-range filter. change it to use the `@window_end` macro so it matches console behavior.

kevin: and add TraceKey usage in the TS sample — we need that in every snippet otherwise tracing-based cost joins are confusing.

rachel: added TraceKey to TS and the Python snippet. here's the TS line I added:
```
telemetry.startTrace({ traceKey: 'org-5678-session' })
```

ops-bot: preview deploy: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/5310 — status: smoke tests passed, link warnings cleared.

sarah: LGTM content-wise. please add a tiny QA step in the PR description: "open console heatmap for sample org -> run for 20s -> validate cost breakdown shows separate KV-cache line labeled 'KV-cache (prefix-aware)'". Make it explicit.

rachel: done. Added QA step and munged wording to "KV-cache (prefix-aware)". Waiting on final CI then will merge and add changelog entry. Will ping #docs when live.
